# HireDesk

> HireDesk is a comprehensive HR platform and knowledge base designed to help Indian organizations navigate recruitment, payroll, compliance, and workforce management.

HireDesk provides practical guidance on Indian employment law, statutory compliance (PF, ESIC), payroll administration, and HR best practices tailored for Indian SMEs and enterprises. The platform combines educational content with actionable HR resources and community contributions.

## Key Topics

- Indian workplace compliance
- Payroll & benefits (PF, ESIC)
- Recruitment & hiring
- Workforce planning
- Employee experience & culture
- Performance management
- Labour laws (India)
- HR technology & analytics
- Industrial relations
- SME HR operations
- Employee lifecycle
- HR resources & templates
- Statutory compliance
- Shop-floor management
- HR practices

## Core Platform

- [Home](https://hiredesk.in): HireDesk homepage covering HR platform, payroll, compliance for India
- [About](https://hiredesk.in/about): About HireDesk HR platform and its mission for Indian workplaces
- [Why Trust HireDesk?](https://hiredesk.in/why-trust-hiredesk): HireDesk credibility, values, and approach to HR content

## HR Operations & Compliance

- [Compliance & Labour Laws](https://hiredesk.in/compliance-and-labour-laws): Indian employment law compliance and statutory requirements guide
- [Payroll, PF & Benefits](https://hiredesk.in/payroll-pf-and-benefits): Payroll, PF, ESIC, and statutory benefits administration for India
- [Workforce Planning & Manpower](https://hiredesk.in/workforce-planning-and-manpower): Workforce planning, manpower management, and capacity planning guide
- [Industrial Relations & Factory HR](https://hiredesk.in/industrial-relations-and-factory-hr): Industrial relations, factory HR, and shop-floor management guide

## Talent & People Management

- [Recruitment & Hiring](https://hiredesk.in/recruitment-and-hiring): Guide to recruitment, hiring, onboarding, and screening processes
- [Performance & Development](https://hiredesk.in/performance-and-development): Performance management, employee development, and feedback frameworks
- [Employee Experience & Culture](https://hiredesk.in/employee-experience-and-culture): Guide to employee experience, workplace culture, and engagement

## Specialized HR Guides

- [SME HR Operations](https://hiredesk.in/sme-hr-operations): HR operations guide for small and medium enterprises in India
- [HR Tech & Analytics](https://hiredesk.in/hr-tech-and-analytics): HR technology, analytics, and workforce metrics guide for India
